claims.evidence: Seller’s condition statement is incomplete; witness photos do not clearly confirm scratches/dents/port wear.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (Mark II vs claimed Mark III) affects value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model text on the top/bottom plate and the camera’s menu “About/Model” screen showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case identified body from the photos (EOS 5D Mark II) rather than the claimed Mark III.

risks.risk: Lens not included or not shown; without a lens the kit value drops significantly.
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens attached (front + mount connection) or separate clear photos of the lens model and condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only (no lens) until a lens is shown.

risks.risk: Unknown physical condition (scratches, dents, cracked ports/buttons) not clearly verifiable from the angles provided.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports (USB/HDMI), card door, hot shoe, and corners/edges under light, plus a screen-on shot showing any dead pixels/lines.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic wear and possible port/button issues (no guarantee of full function).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches) and whether it has been cleaned.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at high f-stop (e.g., f/16) and a close photo of the sensor area (mirror up) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially dusty/needs cleaning (reduced value).

risks.risk: Functionality not tested (shutter count, autofocus accuracy, button/dial responsiveness, video/recording).
risks.proof: Short video clip showing autofocus lock on a moving subject and a playback clip; also a screen showing shutter count (if available) or a menu screen with usage info.

risks.risk: Battery health and completeness of accessories (batteries/charger/memory card/strap/cables) not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of both batteries, charger model, memory card, and all included accessories laid out; plus a screen-on shot confirming battery level and charging.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing/uncertain accessories and worst-case battery health.

proof_requests: Send clear photos showing the exact model (Mark II vs Mark III) from the top/bottom and a menu “About” screen.
Show whether a lens is included: photo with lens attached and lens model/condition (front, mount, and any markings).
Provide close-ups of ports, card door, hot shoe, and all corners/edges under light.
Send a sensor/dust test shot (blank white wall at high f-stop) and a screen-on shot.
Show both batteries and the charger (and Godox trigger if included) laid out, plus a short autofocus + playback test clip.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, but key value drivers (lens, accessories, condition, sensor, and functionality) are not shown. So it can be priced at the worst-case based on the identified body, while treating unshown accessories and performance as unverified.
